_format: Anthropic Messages API tool definitions (name / description / input_schema). For OpenAI-style function calling use {"type": "function", "function": {"name", "description", "parameters": input_schema}}.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Look up one order by its order number. Returns the full order: customer email and name, status, line items, discount, amounts, shipping address, shipping method, shipments, return / cancellation / exception info. The order number must be digits only (for example "10231"); any other format returns invalid_argument.

tools.name: find_orders_by_email
tools.description: List the orders placed with an email address (oldest first) as summaries: order_id, created_at, status, total, currency, item_count. Returns not_found when the email has no orders. Call get_order for details.

tools.name: get_tracking
tools.description: Carrier tracking for an order: order_status and, for each shipment, carrier, tracking_number, status and the scan events (ts, location, code, description). Unshipped orders return an empty shipments list. The order number must be digits only.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Look up a product by SKU (format AAA-000, e.g. "DRS-004"). Returns name, category, current price, compare-at price, price history, material, colours, sizes, stock by size, final-sale flag and fit note. If the customer only gives a product name, find the SKU in the catalog_index knowledge-base document first.
